summary: Frontend-only i18n verification for Makallakap. Validated all 4 UI languages (TR default, EN, DE, RU) via the language selector in Settings, verified in-session UI localization on Home + Settings, persistence via localStorage key 'mk_lang' across reload in the same context, and fresh-session default falls back to Türkçe. No red-screen errors. Static review of the 4 locale files (tr/en/de/ru.ts) confirms full string parity across sections (tabs, home, browse, categories, detail, favorites, recent, quiz incl. difficulty/timed, flashcards, achievements, settings incl. sizes, common, cat). Proverb CONTENT is never referenced by translations — the i18n layer only exposes UI strings and category label mappings; the search index and proverb text remain sourced from proverbs.json in Kyrgyz/Turkish (content integrity is structurally guaranteed by design).

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not from i18n change; pre-existing across the app. Consider migrating in a future pass.

action_items: None blocking for this iteration — i18n behavior meets all acceptance criteria (switch, persist, default, no crash).
Optional: migrate remaining `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN Web console deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: src/i18n/tr.ts is the source-of-truth type (TrType = typeof TR); en/de/ru all import `import type { TrType } from './tr'` and are annotated as TrType, so TypeScript enforces string parity across languages — good.
LanguageContext.tsx correctly gates on `ready` (default `tr` until AsyncStorage read completes) and writes to key 'mk_lang' as documented.
settings.tsx renders LANGUAGES via testIDs lang-tr / lang-en / lang-de / lang-ru with an active check icon — matches spec.
Category labels are localized via `t.cat[key]` fallback to the key, meaning any un-mapped category still renders in Turkish (safe fallback).
i18n strings are UI-only; proverb text/meaning/explanation are read directly from src/data/proverbs.json — content integrity is structurally protected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App persists selected UI language in localStorage under key 'mk_lang'. Because each new Playwright context resets storage, to validate a non-default language you MUST switch it via Settings within the SAME context (home-settings-button cog → tap lang-<key>) and then navigate using header-back-button / bottom tabs. Direct-opening /settings in a fresh context leaves back-stack empty and back becomes a no-op. Language default in a fresh/cleared session is Türkçe.

verified_flows.content_integrity_by_design: i18n keys never reference proverb text/meaning/explanation; those are read verbatim from src/data/proverbs.json

rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found for this iteration.
